name: daniel-km/omeka-s-module-vips
description: Module for Omeka S: Create thumbnails with Vips, the quickest and memory efficient library to create thumbnails with advanced features.

suggest.ext-vips: Php extension for vips (recommended for performance with jcupitt/vips v1). Not needed for cli mode.

_note_provide: As warned below, ext-vips is not provided, but the module requires either ext-vips, either vips-cli.

warnings:
This module requires either:
- library jcupitt/vips v1 with php extension php-vips, recommended for production,
- library jcupitt/vips v2 with php extension php-ffi enabled in php-ini, with security implications,
- or the cli tool vips from the standard package libvips-tools.
The availability of vips is not checked by composer: check the module config page in Omeka.
